summary.text: Tracy Steele is a Democratic member of the Arkansas House of Representatives for District 72, which covers part of Pulaski County.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists House service beginning in 1999 and Senate service from 2003, including as Senate Majority Leader, and gives Steele's occupation as consultant and trainer.

sources.title: Representative Tracy Steele (D) - Arkansas State Legislature
